requiredFindings.title: The observation recheck omits the required file owners
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The fence is held and the spelled rechecks pass. After selection.pair or a lineage node is captured, its owner, mode, link count or ACL changes. Step 4 repeats a set that has no required-file-owner limb, so the session accepts the capture.

requiredFindings.title: An incomplete installation makes doctor emit one defect
requiredFindings.failureScenario: Doctor reaches an incomplete I whose two structural defects are the inherited-two-defects case. doctor-cases.json produces count 2 and two entries. Item 12 produces one CONFIG.CUSTODY_REFUSED entry, subject installation-incomplete, and defectsFound 1. A partial root of 256 actual defects is produced at exit 0 by partial-capacity-no-notice, and a partial root of 257 actual defects refuses at exit 4. Both become that single entry.

requiredFindings.title: Charging every busy retry spends the ledger before the 5 s row
requiredFindings.failureScenario: A writer holds the fence for 5 s. Each nonblocking attempt spends the gate's flock charge of 3 edges. The 131072-edge session ledger refuses the charge inside the wait, and item 6 ends on WORK.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED with fault cause host-invariant. S7 level 0 ends that wait on PROJECT.BUSY.

requiredFindings.title: The shared step 0 treats a missing ancestor as I's absence
requiredFindings.failureScenario: Application Support is present and OpenSIP is absent. The shared 468b walk returns Absent without retaining OpenSIP or observing I, and 468c maps Absent only to INSTALLATION.NOT_INITIALIZED. Item 7 admits that row only when I was observed absent under a retained OpenSIP.

scope: Law 458c r1: the read-side omission premise, the observation path, and the doctor note.
